_help: Hand edits that win over the automatic ones. posts.<code>: title, kind (reel | client | edit), blurb, show (true keeps a post the duplicate check hid). hide: post codes never shown. clients: extra @handles for the 'Edited for' credits. tagline: the line under his name. about: paragraphs for the About section. Run `node scripts/build.mjs` after editing (GitHub does it for you on push).
